'''Sh'alla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]] youth, who lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Sh'alla was a member of the [[Jaraana irstat]] and she lived with them in their village in the jungles of Cularin. When the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] set fire to the village, the flames warped the door of the building that Sh'alla was in, trapping her. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] attempted to rescue her.
